summary: Node-graph application and local API for model-based creative workflows. It can orchestrate image generation and other workflows; actual outputs and terms depend on models and custom nodes.
use_when: Explore a model-driven image workflow with explicit model provenance
Reuse a graph through its documented local API
avoid_when: Need simple deterministic raster operations: ImageMagick
Need video encoding or muxing: FFmpeg
